title: Thomas Winterton's scalp separated from skull after digging
summary: Thomas Winterton tells of Thomas Winterton's scalp separated from skull after digging, about 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> One day, I decided to do some digging. And then, 3 days after, I noticed that I had a goose egg on the back of my head.

plain: Thomas Winterton, introduced as the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something that happened to him after he dug on the land. He says that three days after a day of digging he found a big lump, a "goose egg", on the back of his head, and the story as told is that his scalp had come away from his skull. He tells it as a sign that disturbing the ground there can hurt the people who do it.
